nom: medicube Deep Vitamin C Capsule Serum

segments.oily: The reviewer with oily skin describes the texture as pleasantly light for her skin type, though it was too early in her use to judge any dramatic change.
segments.dry: The reviewer with dry skin reports the serum layered nicely with her moisturizer, hydrating without causing irritation or tightness.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination skin, oil-prone in the T-zone, says she is normally careful about adding oily products but found this one doesn't feel oily or tacky despite its appearance.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and a subtle glow after use; however, two reviewers caution that the essential oils and botanical extracts in the formula can irritate or even burn sensitive skin, especially if it isn't paired carefully with other products.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or sun-damaged skin report brighter, smoother-looking skin, describing vitamin C as especially valuable for the toll sun exposure and age have taken on their complexion.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging or sun damage, including one describing her skin as older and crepey, report brighter, smoother-looking skin and some softening of fine lines, though effects on fine lines are described as gradual or still to be determined.
concerns.dehydration: This is one of the most consistently reported benefits: reviewers across skin types describe fast-absorbing, non-greasy hydration that leaves skin plump and dewy.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, or mild freckling with regular use, including one who specifically credits it with lightening dark spots after months of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including one who says it dries out active acne quickly; one reviewer, however, describes a severe reaction that filled her face with a rash-like breakout.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination, oil-prone T-zones report the serum absorbs without adding shine or oiliness, and none report it made their skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Contains essential oils that may sensitize skin over time

テクスチャはかなりサラサラしていました。 脂性肌の私にはちょうど良いかも。 使ってまだ数回しか経っていないので効果はまだあまりわかりませんが、肌の調子が劇的に変わるってわけでは無さそう。 香りもほぼ無く使いやすい商品だとは思います！

I have sensitive skin and needed something that i could adjust to and be easy on the skin. I've been using medicube vit C for over months now and my skin has seen so much improvement. Its brighter, smoother and dark spot are lightened! I've seen then added other Medicube product to my daily skin rountine 💗

I’m liking this a lot so far. I have combo skin, prone to oiliness in the T-zone, and so I am careful not to add oily products to my skin. Despite the appearance of this serum, it doesn’t feel oily (or even tacky) on my skin. A little goes a long way, so it seems the value for money is there. I only used three drops on my face (one per check and one on my forehead). That was just right to cover my entire face. Another drop for the neck if you wish. It instantly gave me a subtle dewy glow. I barely detect a scent. Just a FAINT citrus smell perhaps, which may come from a fruit extract I spot in the ingredients. But I’d put this into the nearly unscented category. I liked this enough that I put my go-to rosehip oil into my cabinet for now and have switched to this!

extraits.titre: My Skin Started Looking Like I Actually Get Enough Sleep ✨🍊
extraits.texte: I’ve tried a lot of vitamin C serums over the years, and this one has quickly become a favorite. The texture is lightweight, absorbs fast, and doesn’t leave that sticky “my face could trap lint” feeling some serums have. The little vitamin capsules melt right into the skin and make the serum feel a bit more luxurious than your average skincare step. After using it consistently, my skin started looking brighter, smoother, and more even overall. It gives a healthy glow without making me look greasy or overly shiny. I also appreciate that it feels hydrating in addition to brightening. My skin is dry, and this layered nicely with moisturizer without irritation or tightness. The formula feels gentle enough for everyday use, which I have done for over a month now. Overall, this serum makes my complexion look fresher and more awake — like I drink green juice and make good life choices, even when I don't always...

I've been using this Medicube Deep Vitamin C Capsule Serum now for 4 days in the morning. I really like it. I'm older and my skin has taken a toll with some sun damage because I was an idiot in my younger years. This serum goes on seamlessly and you don't need a lot. I love the fact that it leaves no residue at all. The fragrance is ever so vague of a soft citrus. I then use one of my moisturizers with retinal afterwards. I do see my skin brighter and showing signs of improvement. The price is not bad at all for this bottle compared to so so many others on the market. Vitamin C is so essential for aging skin and this serum is a wonderful way to deliver it.
